text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Spring Stakes, Matikanefukukitaru's "Dragon Gate" and our spring hurdle to the Classics, is upon us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to soar through the race like a carp swimming up a waterfall and show everyone her transformation into a fearsome classic-year racer, Matikanefukukitaru heads to the track.
